summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 2, best version). It draws square ABCD with solid sides, solid diagonal BD (heavier line), solid BE and BF, and dashed EF as one path with E on AD and F on CD. Labels A, B, C, D, E, F are placed. The automatic Critic scored v2 at 0.93 with no open issues and must_repair=false. The unlabeled crossing of EF and BD is intentionally not labelled.
